items.clock: Set network clock from system time

delete_pc.body:
Delete all parental controls?

This wipes the PIN and every restriction, and cannot be undone.

unlink.body: Unlink the companion app (Nintendo Switch Parental Controls) from this console?

clock.body:
The network clock has never been set on this console (it is offline or can't reach Nintendo's time servers).

The play timer does not count down without it.

Set the network clock from the system time now?

clock_overwrite.body:
The network clock is already set.

Overwrite it with the system time? Only do this if the system time is correct: the play timer counts its days by the network clock.

play_timer.title: Play timer

remove.body:
Remove the daily play-time limit (all days)?

A bedtime alarm, if set, is kept.

play_timer.numpad_all: Daily play-time limit for ALL days  (0 = block every day)
play_timer.ok_all_zero: Play-time limit written: 0 minutes/day — no play allowed any day. (Use 'Remove play-time limit' to turn the limit off instead.)
play_timer.fw_unsupported:
This console runs firmware {}.{}.{}.

Setting the play timer needs firmware 21.0.0 or newer (tested on 22.1.0). Nothing was written.
play_timer.need_pin:
Set a parental-control PIN first (main menu → Set / change parental control PIN).

Without a PIN the system silently discards play-timer settings.
play_timer.unlock_failed: Could not pause parental controls for the write (error 0x{:08X}). Nothing was written.
play_timer.write_failed: Failed to write the play timer (error 0x{:08X}).
play_timer.relock_failed:
The new settings were written, but parental controls could not be switched back on automatically.

On the HOME menu, select the parental-controls banner and turn parental controls back on.

mode.body: When the daily limit (or bedtime) is reached:
mode.ok_suspend: When time is up, the software will be suspended.
mode.ok_alarm: When time is up, only a notification will be shown.
mode.need_limit: Set a daily limit or bedtime alarm first.

bedtime.invalid: Not a valid time. Enter HHMM, 0000–2359
bedtime.varies_note: The alarm differs from day to day (set in the companion app); shown above is the first day that has one. Set and Turn off apply to every day.
bedtime.mismatch:
The bedtime alarm was written, but the system reads it back differently: {}, {} until {}.

Please save a diagnostic report (main menu) and attach it to a bug report.

perday.title: Per-day play-time limits
perday.section_days: Per-day limits (A to edit; (*) marks staged changes)

pin_gate.title: Central control authentication
pin_gate.headline: Authenticate with the central server to continue.
pin_gate.hint: Enter the console PIN if configured, then verify the server connection. (B) exit
pin_gate.read_failed: Could not read the console's PIN (error 0x{:08X}).

init_error.headline: Could not open the parental-control service.
init_error.body: This homebrew only works on a console running CFW (Atmosphère); a stock retail console can't open the pctl service.
